name: AE Member Enrollment — Pace Gauge
description: Quick visual check on how far along Member Annual Enrollment is: actual completion rate vs. the expected pace for this point in the cycle, shown as a literal thermometer. Expected pace is calculated per wave across each wave's own window and weighted by wave size; before the cycle opens it shows a neutral 'Not Open Yet' state with no pace judgement. Excludes Portico employees. Member half of a stylistic pair with a separate Employer widget.

feeds.description: Same consolidated model as sac-member-enrollment-widget/sac-member-operational-widget -- all 9 dimensions in this exact order -- RowKind, EventDate, Wave, Enrollment_Status, Defaulted, Defaulted_Timing, ActivityDate, Membership_Type, Is_Portico_Employee. This widget only reads the StatusByWave row-kind (Wave, Enrollment_Status) and excludes Is_Portico_Employee = 'Yes'.
